name: Monk Ring Dancer
body:
Monks were the first to master the use of dancing rings as a form of combat. The exotic-yet-simple nature of the weapons speak well to the style of monks, and by incorporating their ki into the weapons, they can make them even more powerful.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Ring dancers gain proficiency with dancing rings, and lose proficiency with shortspears, slings, and spears.

This alters the monk’s weapon proficiencies.
